tabpfn.cap_reason: compute safety valve: a TabPFN point took longer than 480s on CPU, larger sizes were skipped
tabpfn.categorical_encoding: OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown='use_encoded_value', unknown_value=-1, encoded_missing_value=-2) fitted on the train subsample only

lgbm_tuning_policy.subsampled_sizes: fresh Optuna search per (size, seed): n_trials=10, 3-fold CV
lgbm_tuning_policy.full_train: reuses the 30-trial tuned params from results/lgbm_baseline.json
lgbm_tuning_policy.fit_s_note: fit_s includes the Optuna search time where tuning ran fresh

logreg: untuned linear reference: OneHot(ignore unknowns, NaN->'missing') + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)
runtime_note: total_runtime_seconds is this invocation's wall time; the CSV was built incrementally and may span multiple resumed invocations
